subject.title: [Bug]: OpenAI-compatible streaming tool calls are dropped when provider omits finish_reason

question: Should OpenClaw execute native OpenAI-compatible streamed tool calls when `delta.tool_calls` are complete and the raw SSE stream ends with `[DONE]`, even if no final `finish_reason` chunk is emitted?
rationale: This is both a compatibility fix and a tool-execution boundary change; source evidence shows the bug, but only maintainers can accept the safe clean-stream contract versus keeping strict `finish_reason` gating.

options.title: Accept clean-DONE tool execution
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98124 after normal checks, preserving EOF-without-DONE and visible-text safeguards while fixing affected providers.

options.title: Require exact-provider proof first
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a redacted Evolink or equivalent live run proves the originally reported no-finish stream path end to end.

options.title: Keep finish_reason required
options.body: Reject the linked PR direction and document that providers must emit an explicit tool-call finish reason before OpenClaw executes streamed tool calls.

recommendation.title: Accept clean-DONE tool execution
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98124 after normal checks, preserving EOF-without-DONE and visible-text safeguards while fixing affected providers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete reviewed and approved the adjacent tool-call execution-boundary changes and is the clearest routing owner for the remaining safety contract choice.
